blurb: Epic Flight Academy provides professional pilot training programs including commercial single and multi-engine instrument pilot licenses. Training is FAA-approved Part 141 with a fast-track option and a high first-time pass rate. The school offers housing options, transportation, and a large fleet of new aircraft including simulators.
